content.short: KyberSwap is a multichain DEX aggregator and limit order platform with thousands of liquidity sources offering competitive trading rates on Mantle.
content.description: KyberSwap is one of DeFi's most established DEX aggregators, originally founded in 2017 by Loi Luu and operating across dozens of blockchain networks. The platform aggregates liquidity from thousands of sources to provide optimal swap rates, and also operates KyberSwap Elastic  its own concentrated liquidity pools. Advanced features include limit orders, zap-in functionality, and cross-chain swaps. KyberSwap is fully deployed on Mantle Network with a comprehensive set of trading tools.
